name: Filippo Pacini
summary: Italian anatomist and pathologist who discovered lamellar corpuscles along digital nerves.

name: Gianfranco Natale
summary: Author of this biographical essay on Filippo Pacini.

attributes.affiliation: Department of Human Morphology and Applied Biology, University of Pisa

name: Jacob Henle
summary: German anatomist who praised Pacini's discovery and co-published on Pacinian corpuscles.

name: Albert Kölliker
summary: Swiss anatomist who co-published with Henle on Pacinian corpuscles.

name: Pistoia
summary: Italian city where Pacini was born and worked until 1840.

name: Pisa
summary: Italian city where Pacini worked from 1840 to 1846.

name: Florence
summary: Italian city where Pacini worked from 1847 onward.

name: Lucca
summary: Italian city where the Quinta Unione degli Scienziati Italiani was held in 1843.

name: Società Medico-Fisica of Florence
summary: Medical society in Florence where Pacini presented research in 1835.

name: Prima Riunione degli Scienziati Italiani
summary: Italian scientists meeting held in Pisa in 1839.

name: Quinta Unione degli Scienziati Italiani
summary: Italian scientists meeting held in Lucca in 1843.

name: Nuovo Giornale de' Letterati
summary: Journal that published Pacini's research on corpuscles in 1836.

name: Nuovi organi scoperti nel corpo umano
summary: Pacini's 1840 book on the history, anatomy, and physiology of the new organs.

name: Ueber die Pacinischen Körperchen an den Nerven des Menschen und der Säugethiere
summary: 1844 book by Henle and Kölliker with further observations on Pacinian corpuscles.

name: Pacinian corpuscles
summary: Large ovoid corpuscles with concentric lamellae surrounding nerve endings, concerned with touch and deep pressure sensation.

name: Anatomical Museum of Pisa
summary: Museum holding Pacini's preparations of lamellar corpuscles.

name: Anatomical Museum of Florence
summary: Museum holding Pacini's preparations of lamellar corpuscles.
